text: City Council on June 26, 2018 directed that staff report back to City Council with an update on the implementations inclusive of the developments in the sharing of data in reference to the Coroner's Jury recommendations on the inquest into the death of Grant Faulkner. Subsequent to Mr. Faulkner's death, Mr. Bradley Chapman unfortunately was found deceased on our City streets. It would be appropriate for staff to include materials on Bradley Chapman's inquest when reporting to the October 2, 2019 meeting of City Council on the Coroner's Jury recommendations on the inquest into the death of Grant Faulkner as both inquests address issues impacting homelessness.

City Council on June 18 and 19, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the General Manager, Shelter Support and Housing Administration to report on the Coroner’s Jury recommendations on the inquest of Bradley Chapman when reporting to the October 2, 2019 City Council meeting on the Coroner's Jury recommendations on the inquest into the death of Grant Faulkner.
